[[File:Ultimo_Vista.jpg|thumb|300px|The Corusca Circus.]]

The '''Corusca Circus''' was an accumulation of public buildings located at the heart of the [[Old District]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in the ancient [[City/Legends|city]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> All streets in that district led to the Corusca Circus; it was distinguished from other parts of the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] by its old-style bright yellowish lighting and architecture.<ref name="TCSWE" />
